rulings.why: Holy Cross's own all-time results list the 1/27/78 UConn game at neutral site N42 = Colonial Classic, Boston Garden (not Worcester); BC's record book shows the same two-night Colonial Classic at Boston Garden (BC-UMass 1/27, BC-UConn 1/28). Record book (N) is right; app's A is wrong. Side note: Holy Cross prints the score as 76-63, while UConn's record book and the app have 78-63 - score not settled here.

set.note: Lost 66-73 on the court; Utah later forfeited the game for using an ineligible player, so it counts as a UConn win.

rulings.why: Provo Daily Herald, Jan. 10, 1980, p. 6 (quoted from a search snippet; the page itself is behind a bot check): Utah declared Danny Vranes ineligible Dec. 22, 1979 over a summer course (an Ottawa University correspondence course; SI's Mar. 2, 1981 Utah story ties it to the FBI's Ottawa credits probe). Utah had to forfeit the games he played while ineligible, which dropped it from 10-5 to 5-10, and the WAC turned down his appeal. Utah's wins before Dec. 22 were Utah State, Cal State Fullerton, UConn (Dec. 8), Nevada and Pacific; Sports-Reference's own forfeit table lists Utah 4L by forfeit and 'Connecticut 1979-80 20-9 -> 21-8, 1W by forfeit'. So the record book is right: officially a UConn forfeit win, and the 66-73 on-court score is also correct. Caveat: Utah's own 2006-07 media guide ignores the forfeits and still lists W 73-66 with an 18-10 record.

rulings.why: Both semifinals (UConn-BC, URI-Holy Cross) were Thursday Mar. 1 per BC's and Holy Cross's own records. The NYT game story on the final ran in the Sunday Mar. 4 paper, while the Saturday Mar. 3 paper (which carried Friday-night games such as DePaul-Notre Dame) had none, so the final was Saturday Mar. 3. Record book (3/3) is right; app (3/2) is wrong.

rulings.why: BC's own record book gives Jan. 10, 1980 (a Thursday) in two separate places: the series list and the 1979-80 game list. That matches UConn's record book. Against it, both teams' preseason schedules in Street & Smith's 1979-80 yearbook list the game for Wednesday Jan. 9, which matches SR/the app and fits UConn's usual Wed/Sat home pattern that season. So either the game was moved a day, or both record books are off. I found no game report from the time: the NYT Jan. 10/11 roundup headlines don't mention it, and the Courant, Globe, BC Heights and UConn Daily Campus for that week were unreachable or not digitized. BC's series list also gives the site as Hartford, which is doubtful: the Hartford Civic Center didn't reopen until Feb. 1980 (UConn's first game back there was 2/9 vs URI), and UConn's book marks this as a plain Storrs home game. Leaning record-book date (1/10). Upgrade to high only with a newspaper.
